bio.text: Toby Overdorf represents District 85 in the Florida House of Representatives, first elected in 2018, according to the House's official biography.
The profile lists Overdorf as an environmental consultant from Palm City who was born in Newport, Rhode Island, and moved to Florida in 1992.
Overdorf holds a B.S. in biology from Union College (1991) and a master's in biology and an environmental MBA from Florida Atlantic University.

sources.title: Tobin Rogers "Toby" Overdorf's official House profile
